title: Build a Trie in Go — 3 turns
description: Three turns build a Trie: turn 1 adds Insert/Search, turn 2 adds Delete, turn 3 adds StartsWith prefix search.

task_spec.prompt: Implement `Insert(word)` and `Search(word)` in `trie/trie.go`. Insert: iterate over runes of word, create child nodes as needed, mark the last node as isEnd=true. Search: traverse nodes for each rune; if any rune is missing return false; return isEnd at the last node. Run `go test ./...`.
followup_prompts: Good. Now implement `Delete(word string) bool`: traverse to the word, if not found return false. Mark the end node isEnd=false. Optionally prune leaf nodes that are no longer needed. Run `go test ./...` and fix any failures.

Final step: implement `StartsWith(prefix string) []string` — find the node at the end of prefix, then DFS to collect all complete words under it. Each collected word should be the full word (prefix + suffix). Run `go test ./...` — all 6 tests must pass.
success_criteria: Insert/Search work for exact words including shared prefixes
Search returns false for prefixes that aren't full words
Delete removes exact word without affecting words sharing its prefix
Delete returns false for words not in the trie
StartsWith returns all words with given prefix
